note: Committed before any OCR run scored anything. Defines what is measured, on which renders, and the bar that decides whether the 图片 / 截图 input ships visible or stays hidden. Prose version: docs/EVALUATION.md section 8.

runtime.name: onnxruntime-web
runtime.execution: WebAssembly SIMD, one thread (GitHub Pages is not cross-origin isolated). WebGPU is not used.

weights.model: PP-OCRv5 mobile text detection + recognition (PaddlePaddle, Apache-2.0), ONNX conversion

served_from.note: Same files and SHA-256 as CreditLens 0.35 (configs/table-check.json). Copied from base_url at build time on GitHub Actions by scripts/fetch_ocr_models.py with a size and SHA-256 check; the page checks SHA-256 again. Hugging Face's WAF answered headless Chromium on Actions with a CAPTCHA on 2026-11-10 (CreditLens runs 42776613837, 42777096938), so a direct Hugging Face fetch cannot be the tested path. The test browser is not disguised.

postprocess.frozen_before_test: The engine (these values and the OCR / joining code) is frozen in a commit named in docs/EVALUATION.md 8.6 before the test run. low_confidence is a UI hint only and is not tuned.

dev.use: tuning; any number of runs; outputs may be read

test.use: one scored run on the frozen engine; the first run is the result

items.name: blind_v2
items.note: Sequestered since 792631a. The job writes only ids and numbers for it (no script text, no OCR text); nobody opens its renders.

render.label: SYNTHETIC
render.where: In Chromium on GitHub Actions (Playwright), canvas 2D, fonts from Ubuntu packages fonts-noto-cjk, fonts-wqy-zenhei, fonts-arphic-ukai. The harness fails if a font is not present (its glyph widths equal the fallback's).

frames.what: subtitle-style video frames, one image per subtitle
frames.split: SRT items: one frame per cue. Text items: cut after 。！？；!?; ; a piece over 36 characters is cut after the last ，,、 that keeps it within 36, else hard-wrapped at 36. Line breaks inside a frame at 18 characters.
frames.text_join: lines inside a frame joined with nothing; frames joined with a newline (the same as parse_srt)

poster.what: poster or screenshot: the whole script as paragraphs on one or more portrait images
poster.paragraphs: source line breaks; SRT items one paragraph per cue
poster.overflow: continues on another image of the same conditions
poster.text_join: wrapped lines joined with nothing; paragraphs and images joined with a newline

backgrounds.gradient: two-colour linear gradient, text colour by mean luminance
backgrounds.busy: seeded random shapes and noise in mid tones; frames keep the outline or box style, posters draw text with a 2 px contrasting outline

render.assignment: Per set and layout, items in id order; the full factor grid (font x background x JPEG x style or body size) is shuffled with the seed and item k takes cell k mod grid size. Every image of one render shares its cell.
render.ground_truth: the exact string drawn on each image and each character's box from canvas measureText

small_print_probe.what: descriptive, not part of the bar: the first sentence of each dev item drawn on a 1080 px wide light screenshot strip at each size, Noto Sans CJK SC, JPEG 0.92
small_print_probe.report: character accuracy by size; the smallest size at or above 95% is quoted on the page as the small-print limit

references.T0: browser engine on the eval text as it is in the set (the existing text path)
references.T1: browser engine on the text exactly as drawn (layout joins applied, no OCR errors)
references.T2: browser engine on the OCR text

metrics.mapping: T1 and T2 spans are mapped to eval-text coordinates: T1 by the renderer's character map, T2 by a Levenshtein alignment of OCR text to drawn text and then the renderer's map.
metrics.matching: the section 2 rule: same category and character IoU >= 0.5, one-to-one greedy by IoU
metrics.char_accuracy: 1 - sum(edit distance) / sum(reference characters) over all images; reference = text drawn on the image; both sides NFKC with whitespace removed; punctuation counts
metrics.layout_retention: share of T0 findings matched by T1
metrics.ocr_retention: share of T1 findings matched by T2
metrics.total_retention: share of T0 findings matched by T2 (what a visitor gets compared with pasting the text)
metrics.ocr_introduced: T2 findings that match no T1 finding, as a share of T2 findings
metrics.clean_flagged: renders of items with no gold span and no T0 finding that have at least one T2 finding, as a share of such renders
metrics.anchor_hit: T2 findings matched to a T1 finding whose box, per image, has IoU >= 0.5 with the union of the drawn boxes of the same characters
metrics.gold: span P/R/F1 against gold for T0 and T2 (secondary; blind_v2 gold is unaudited model labelling)
metrics.disclosures: items whose missing-disclosure list differs between T0 and T2 (reported)
metrics.latency: seconds per image from decoded image to joined text (detection, recognition, joining), P50 and P95 per layout; init seconds; downloaded bytes
metrics.invariants: every T2 finding's quote equals the OCR text slice; every citation shown as verified is in the law snapshot

bar.applies_to: pooled test sets (test, blind_v1, blind_v2), all conditions, first test run on the frozen engine
bar.check_job: the real-OCR visitor check passes at 1440 and 375 px in light and dark
bar.decision: Visible (the 图片 / 截图 input in the workbench, weights in the Pages build) only if every bar holds. Otherwise the input stays out of the public build and the weights are not deployed; the numbers are reported in docs and CHANGELOG. Per-condition results are reported, not gating.
